text: じつは…　わらい　キノコ　たべて　しまってな

structure.jp: わらい　キノコ　たべて　しまってな
structure.en: I went and ate a laughing mushroom, you see

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: てしまう after a verb says the thing happened completely, often by mistake or to your regret. たべて　しまって = 'I went and ate it'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: Stopping on a て-form leaves the sentence open, giving the reason for something already clear (his laughing); な adds 'you see'. しまってな = 'I went and did it, you see...'.
